ctx.x: Then if I asked you about Chick Webb, and you say, his speed, his hands and the way he thought, well, it makes it sound, I mean --

Well, Chick wasn't in that category to me when it came -- he was a great drummer, but Big Sid was like out there on his own; with his speed and his thoughts, he'd fit any band. Chick Webb wouldn't because he was the boss of his band. Oh, yeah. There's a difference. It's hard to explain unless you, you know, you just consider yourself that the man was a great drummer. Big Sid could fit in any band, even in the pit. That's something else to say.
